description: Replace a plain == token comparison with a constant-time comparison to remove a timing side-channel
prompts: auth.py's verify_token(expected, provided) compares tokens with plain `==`, which short-circuits on the first mismatched character - an attacker who can measure response time can recover a valid token one character at a time. Fix it to use a constant-time comparison (hmac.compare_digest), while keeping the same True/False result for matching, mismatched-same-length, and different-length inputs.

setup_files.auth.py:
def verify_token(expected, provided):
    return expected == provided

files.auth.py:
def verify_token(expected, provided):
    return expected == provided

name: fix_python_timing_safe_token_compare
